description: See replies directed at me, in two categories: (1) comments and replies under posts I published; (2) replies to my comments inside other people's posts. My own replies to myself do not count. By default only content newer than the last read is returned; pass since_hours to look further back. mark_read=true marks the returned items as read — only pass it when the user has explicitly seen them or you have relayed the content, otherwise they cannot be retrieved next time.

mark_read.description: Whether to mark these items as read (only applies to the default mode). Do not pass true unless the user confirmed they saw them

since_hours.description: Look-back window in hours, e.g. 24 = last day, 168 = last week. When passed, the read cursor is ignored

name: get_my_post_replies
title: Get Replies to My Posts
